card.name: Joining word in Cockcroft and Gault
card.fires_on: The 'and', hyphen or comma linking the two surnames in 'Cockcroft and Gault' (the creatinine clearance formula). Also the 'and' or comma between author names in citations such as 'Carlin, Bradley P. and Louis'.
